specs.anchorText: Everything difficult about detection flows from that one fact
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, like a friendly XKCD-meets-Kurzgesagt textbook drawing. Split scene, two friendly robots side by side. On the left, a calm robot holds up a single small card with one tidy checkmark, looking at a photo of a busy street; it is relaxed and confident. On the right, a slightly flustered but cheerful robot looks at the very same busy street photo and is frantically drawing many colorful rectangles around several different things at once (a couple of cars, a few pedestrians, a dog), each rectangle a different soft color, juggling a small stack of rectangle cards. The contrast shows one easy answer versus a whole variable-length list of located answers. Expressive characters, minimal clutter, soft pastel palette, no text or lettering or numbers in the image, one clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A calm robot on the left holds a single label card for one whole-image classification, while a busier robot on the right draws many colorful bounding rectangles around several cars, pedestrians, and a dog in the same street photo, depicting how detection replaces one label with a variable-length list of located, classified boxes.
specs.caption: A classifier answers one question; a detector commits to where and what for every object it can find, and never knows in advance how many that will be.

specs.anchorText: the three metrics of this section form one ladder, each rung averaging the rung below
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background with generous margins, friendly textbook style. A friendly robot nervously holding a single report card that shows just one big decimal grade (no readable text, just a stylized number shape), sweating a tiny cartoon bead. Behind the robot, a gentle three-rung ladder rises, the bottom rung showing two overlapping rectangle shapes (one box judged), the middle rung a small rising staircase curve (a class summarized), the top rung a stack of those staircases averaged into the single grade. The ladder visually feeds upward into the one decimal on the card. Soft palette, expressive but calm, gentle humor about exam anxiety, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: A worried cartoon robot holds a report card showing a single grade, behind it a three-rung ladder rises from two overlapping boxes (IoU judging one box) to a small precision-recall staircase (average precision for one class) to a stack of staircases averaged (mean average precision), showing how the three metrics build on each other into one number.
specs.caption: IoU grades a box, AP grades a class, and mAP grades the whole detector: a metric ladder where each rung quietly averages the one below it into a single nervous decimal.

specs.anchorText: do not try to classify every possible box in an image
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, friendly textbook style. A two-station cartoon assembly line inside a tidy little factory. At the first station, a fast scout robot with a stamp quickly slaps a few hopeful empty rectangle frames onto a conveyor belt over an image, ignoring the rest of the image (a sign of proposing a manageable handful of regions). At the second station, a careful inspector robot wearing a magnifying loupe examines each proposed rectangle one at a time and neatly labels and tightens it. The conveyor carries the rectangles from the proposer to the inspector. Two clear stages, one shared belt. Expressive, gentle, soft palette, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: A two-station cartoon assembly line: a fast scout robot stamps a handful of candidate rectangle frames onto a conveyor over an image, and a careful inspector robot with a magnifying loupe then examines, labels, and tightens each proposed box one at a time, illustrating the two-stage propose-then-classify R-CNN pipeline.
specs.caption: Two-stage detection is a polite division of labor: one worker proposes a few regions worth looking at, a second studies only those, which is why it stays accurate but never the fastest on the line.

specs.anchorText: the gradient is dominated by the enormous mass of easy background examples
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, friendly textbook style. A gentle teacher robot stands before a huge crowd. Most of the crowd are tiny, pale, nearly-faded identical background blobs all sleepily mumbling the same easy answer, drawn very light and small so they recede. A few bright, colorful, distinct little object characters (a tiny car, a tiny dog, a tiny person shape) stand out vividly in front. The teacher robot gently turns a soft volume knob that fades the huge easy crowd quieter and smaller while the few bright hard examples stay loud and clear. The metaphor is down-weighting the easy majority so the rare important ones are heard. Expressive, warm, soft palette, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: A teacher robot turns a volume knob that fades a vast crowd of pale, identical, sleepy background blobs into near silence while a few bright, distinct little object characters stay vivid and loud, illustrating how focal loss down-weights the easy background majority so rare foreground examples dominate training.
specs.caption: Focal loss does not throw the easy background away; it simply turns its volume down, so the hundred thousand bored 'background' voices stop drowning out the few objects that actually have something to teach.

specs.anchorText: a location can predict an object directly
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, friendly textbook style. Left side: a tired older cartoon anchor-box character, shaped like a stack of nine differently-shaped rectangle frames worn like heavy luggage, finally setting the heavy stack down with a relieved sigh, retiring on a little bench. Right side: a cheerful nimble robot standing on a single feature-map grid dot, simply pointing outward with four little arrows to the four edges of a soft object outline (left, top, right, bottom), unburdened and free. The contrast is the heavy catalogue of reference boxes versus simply pointing at the edges. Expressive, gentle humor, soft palette, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: On the left a weary anchor-box character sets down a heavy stack of nine differently shaped rectangle frames and retires on a bench, while on the right a nimble robot standing on one grid point simply points four little arrows to the left, top, right, and bottom edges of an object outline, illustrating the anchor-free shift from a hand-tuned catalogue of boxes to direct per-location edge regression.
specs.caption: Anchor-free detection retires the heavy catalogue of guessed rectangles: a single location just points at the four edges of the thing it sits on, no aspect-ratio luggage required.

specs.anchorText: can the network simply output the final set directly
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, friendly textbook style. A small team of identical little assistant robots (object queries) hovering over a shared photo, each politely claiming exactly one different object with a single tidy colored rectangle and a friendly handshake gesture to its assigned object (one robot to a car, one to a dog, one to a person), with no two robots reaching for the same object. A few extra assistant robots stand calmly to the side holding small empty trays, signalling they found nothing this time. Crucially, there is no janitor and no broom cleaning up duplicates, the scene is already tidy. The metaphor is one-to-one set prediction with no non-maximum suppression needed. Expressive, cooperative, soft palette, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: A team of identical little assistant robots each politely claim exactly one distinct object in a shared photo with a single colored box and a handshake, while a few spare robots hold empty trays meaning they found nothing, and no cleanup janitor is present, illustrating DETR's one-to-one set prediction with object queries that needs no non-maximum suppression.
specs.caption: DETR hands out a fixed team of object queries that agree, one each, never to claim the same object twice, so the list arrives tidy and no duplicate-sweeping step is needed afterward.

specs.anchorText: a detector will exploit any shortcut your data offers
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins, friendly textbook style. A proud little robot confidently drawing a bounding box, but instead of boxing the actual product object it is excitedly boxing a faint corner watermark squiggle and the plain studio backdrop, completely ignoring the real object sitting plainly nearby. Its report card floating above shows a big cheerful grade, while a thought bubble reveals it is keying on the watermark and background rather than the thing itself. Gentle, sympathetic humor about a model taking a shortcut. Soft palette, expressive, minimal clutter, one clear visual metaphor, no text or lettering in the image.
specs.alt: A proud cartoon robot draws its bounding box around a faint corner watermark and the studio backdrop instead of the actual product object beside it, while a floating report card shows a high score, illustrating how a detector can inflate its validation mAP by learning a spurious shortcut cue rather than the real object.
specs.caption: A detector will gleefully cheat on any shortcut your data leaves lying around; a beautiful validation mAP that quietly learned the watermark collapses the moment the watermark is gone.
